icp: Customers supervising AI teammates on their paired Mac
pain: Silent browser streams leave stale controls and a fixture race obscures context recovery evidence
revenueHypothesis: Trustworthy control recovery and reliable release evidence support paid teammate workflows
mvpAcceptance: Combine the reviewed heartbeat and context-fixture changes without altering their behavior
Run the complete repository test sequence in a credential-free environment
Verify the real browser recovery fixture on the combined source
Publish a uniquely named draft branch and require live exact-head CI before acceptance
Use the original delivery verifier and independent controller evidence; do not represent blocked scans or missing checks as passed
rollback: Revert only the integration commit or close the isolated draft branch; preserve both original reviewed commits and all customer data. No production deployment is part of this unit.
stopConditions: Stop on a tool denial for that exact action; never bypass it through another credential

Keep production release blocked while security, identity or native distribution evidence is incomplete
